quarterly_data.quarter: GE Vernova press release: GE Vernova secures order aimed to strengthen regional (10-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: GE Vernova will supply a 9E gas turbine and generator for the new Songon combined-cycle power plant near Abidjan, Cote d'Ivoire, selected by developer Songon Energies after financing agreements were signed in June; the plant, built by EPC contractor China Energy International Engineering, is expected to deliver 372 megawatts with an operational launch scheduled for 2029. GE Vernova says it looks forward to applying its expertise in powering the HV substation, providing digital software and long-term services.
quarterly_data.figure: 372 MW plant; 9E gas turbine; operation scheduled 2029
